name: Practiced Discipline
body:
You have continued to improve your disciplines while pursuing other lines of inquiry.

Prerequisite(s): Alchemical discipline class feature.

Benefit(s): The abilities of your alchemical discipline are calculated as though your alchemist level were 4 levels higher, to a maximum effective alchemist level equal to your character level.

Special: If you possess two alchemical disciplines, you must select one of them of which to apply this feat’s benefits.

In that situation, you can select this feat a second time to apply its benefits to both of your alchemical disciplines.

Special: This feat does not affect alchemical disciplines gained through corruptions.
